name: Walter Stiern Library
shortDescription: The campus hub for studying, research help, and quiet workspaces.
longDescription: The Walter Stiern Library is the academic heart of CSUB. It offers individual and group study rooms, computer workstations, course reserves, research databases, and one-on-one help from subject librarians. Whether you need a quiet corner to focus or a place to collaborate on a group project, the library has space for it.
services: Research and citation help from librarians
Access to online journals and databases

name: Student Union
shortDescription: Where student life happens — events, clubs, and a place to hang out.
longDescription: The Student Union is the social center of campus. It hosts student clubs and organizations, cultural and community events, and casual lounges where students relax between classes. Stop in to find flyers about upcoming activities, meet new people, or grab a snack between lectures.
services: Bulletin boards for jobs, housing, and tutoring

name: Science Building
shortDescription: Labs and classrooms for biology, chemistry, physics, and more.
longDescription: The Science Building houses laboratories, lecture halls, and faculty offices for CSUB's natural sciences. Students taking courses in biology, chemistry, geology, physics, and related fields will spend a lot of time here. Look for posted office hours on faculty doors if you need help with coursework.
services: Faculty offices and posted office hours

links.label: School of Natural Sciences, Mathematics, and Engineering

name: Student Recreation Center
shortDescription: Gym, fitness classes, and indoor courts for all CSUB students.
longDescription: The Student Recreation Center is open to enrolled CSUB students and gives you access to weight and cardio equipment, group fitness classes, basketball and volleyball courts, and intramural sports. Bring your Runner Card to check in at the front desk.

name: Runner Café
shortDescription: On-campus dining with hot meals, snacks, and coffee.
longDescription: Runner Café is the main on-campus dining spot, with a rotating menu of hot meals, made-to-order options, grab-and-go snacks, and coffee. Most accepted payment methods include Runner Card meal plans, credit/debit, and cash. Hours vary by day and are typically reduced on weekends and during breaks.
services: Meal plan and Runner Card accepted

name: Advising and Student Services
shortDescription: Help with class registration, majors, graduation, and student support.
longDescription: The Advising and Student Services area is where you go for academic advising, help choosing or changing a major, graduation checks, and questions about financial aid, tutoring, or career planning. New students should visit early in the term to map out their academic plan.
services: Referrals to tutoring and accessibility services
